items.title: Carmen Lundy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 15, 2023
items.q: There was a film that I happened to stumble into, Liza Manelli — it might have been “Arthur” but I’m not sure if it was “Arthur.”

ctx.x: Oh originality. Oh I’m glad you read that. There was a film that I happened to stumble into, Liza Manelli — it might have been “Arthur” but I’m not sure if it was “Arthur.” But the very last scene she’s in a fur coat, she’s the star, and there’s like it’s the end of the film and everyone is like “Liza, Liza, Liza.” And she gets into the limo and a little girl stops her before she gets into the car. And the little girl says, “Liza” and she turns around and of course there’s this cute little girl. And the cute…

As do I. And I have great respect — you know I’ve often felt that every major city in the United States has any number of singers who are blessed with a great voice. But for me the fact that you write your own music, you do your charts, you put all this effort into it, good for you. It’s the best. I’m not sure how to express my admiration for it, but I’m trying.
